landing.hero: Become who you are meant to be.
landing.sub: A premium space where coaches and clients grow together — sessions, practice, dialogue and visible progress, in one calm place.
landing.tryDemo: Try a free AI coaching session
landing.heroNote: Free for your first 3 clients · no card required
landing.journeySub: Every meaningful change follows a path. We built the platform around it.

journey.d: Define goals together in your first session. Everything starts from an honest picture of where you are.
Weekly growth tasks turn insight into habit. Submit, reflect, get feedback that lands.
Progress you can see — milestones, metrics and momentum that compound session after session.

benefits.d: Replace five scattered tools with a single, quiet place for your whole practice.
Tasks, chat and visible progress keep momentum alive between sessions.
Your practice deserves an experience that feels like a high-end studio, not a spreadsheet.
Every record is isolated per coach and client with bank-grade row-level security.

features.d: Plan, hold and track every coaching session.
Assign practice, review submissions, give feedback.
A private channel with every client.
Metrics and milestones that show the journey.
English, Russian and Hebrew with full RTL.
A warm wellness theme and a cinematic dark mode.

stories.q: My clients finally see their own progress. Renewals went up the first month.
I closed four tools and moved everything here. It feels like my own studio.
The weekly tasks keep me honest. I have never stayed this consistent.

landing.pricingSub: Start free. Upgrade when your practice grows.

faq.q: Do my clients pay for the platform?
faq.a: No. Clients join free by invitation from their coach. Only coaches choose a plan.

faq.q: Can I use it in Hebrew or Russian?
faq.a: Yes — the entire interface ships in English, Russian and Hebrew with full right-to-left support.
Every row in the database is protected by row-level security. A coach sees only their clients; a client sees only their own journey.
Yes. Downgrade or cancel in one click — your data stays yours and exportable.

landing.ctaSub: Join coaches who turned their practice into a premium experience.
